note: integrations/kserve applied to a temporary GKE cluster on 2026-11-23 (commit 863cba0). Runs 1 and 2 show two defects of the published v2.0.0-cuda image; run 3 is a test-only override of the same image that adds what deploy/Dockerfile now adds. No image was built or published for this run.

env.nodes: one e2-standard-4, one Spot g2-standard-8 with an NVIDIA L4 (driver 580.178.04, installed by GKE)
env.kserve: v0.21.0, Standard deployment mode, no ingress (requests through a port-forward to the predictor Service)

runs.error: Found no NVIDIA driver on your system
runs.cause: GKE mounts the driver libraries at /usr/local/nvidia/lib64 and the image sets no LD_LIBRARY_PATH: in a pod of the same image torch.cuda.is_available() is False as the image is and True with LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/nvidia/lib64

runs.error: RuntimeError: Failed to find C compiler. Please specify via CC environment variable or set triton.knobs.build.impl.
runs.cause: the weights load on the L4; the first Triton kernel (rms_norm, in the KV layer calibration at startup) needs a C compiler and the image has none

runs.serving_runtime: run 2 with gcc and libc6-dev installed at container start as root, the server then started as the image's user turing (uid 1000); test-only
runs.first_token_note: from turing_ttft_p99_ms and turing_ttft_avg_ms after two requests; Triton compiles each kernel at its first use; not profiled further
